name: Earning Your Salt

angles.text: Ursula Deline studies an orb on your behalf, but only if you bring her the prepared salts that Blackrock summoners use to empower their rituals.

faq.answer: Ursula Deline is a researcher in Stormwind who agrees to inspect an orb for you in exchange for ritual components.

aliases: what is summoners salt used for
faq.answer: Blackrock clan warlocks use specially prepared salts to empower their summoning rituals, and Ursula demands a supply before sharing her research.
faq.q: Why does Ursula need summoner's salt?

aliases: where do i get the salt
faq.answer: The salt is carried by Blackrock summoners encamped within the Redridge Mountains.
faq.q: Where is the summoner's salt found?

aliases: what do you get in return
faq.answer: Ursula promises to study an orb and share the findings of her research once you return with the salt.
faq.q: What does Ursula offer in return?

sections.body: Blackrock summoners in the Redridge Mountains carry specially treated salts to bolster their dark rites. Ursula Deline refuses to examine an orb on your behalf until you secure a supply from those encampments. Once you return to Stormwind with the salt in hand, she has agreed to disclose what her studies uncover.
sections.title: Ritual Salt

summary: Ursula Deline in Stormwind has agreed to study an orb for you, but she demands a service in return. To learn what she discovers, you must venture into the Redridge Mountains and wrest prepared summoning salts from the Blackrock clan.
attribution: In-game quest text: Earning Your Salt
